manifest.label_definition: full expected payload after DIRECT/ASK/TOOL colon; calculator label includes calculator name and exact ordered arguments, joint includes color and pitch
manifest.majority_baseline_scope: per-task constant payload baseline, before runtime final-answer generation; constant-answer concept/missing/safety tasks can reach 100% without task understanding

split_policy.audio: seeded family split with minimal deterministic swaps; low/high each 8 train, 1 validation, 1 test families; all three frequency variants stay together
split_policy.numbers: canonical unordered operand families; both question orientations and all task descendants stay together; reserve (1,2) for test before training

manifest.limitations: synthetic RGB shapes/tones and narrow Chinese templates, not natural multimodal understanding

selection.criterion: Higher exact end-to-end success on the same frozen 84-row validation set; broad small-world coverage is the product goal. No test generations from these stages have been made. Constant-answer baselines and narrow templates limit interpretation.
selection.dpo_disposition: Keep as a documented preference-update comparison. The precommitted CE/KD student experiment continues to use the DPO teacher, distinct from the recommended joint main checkpoint.
selection.recipe_unchanged: No training schedule, model weights, family splits, or student teacher/hyperparameters are changed by this deployment choice.

original_configuration.selection: first style row in the frozen validation split, selected before generation results
original_configuration.timing_scope: one generate_trace call including prompt preparation, device transfers, greedy generation and decoding; CUDA synchronized before and after each call; excludes model loading, startup, HF I/O and weight verification
original_configuration.limitation: one fixed validation prompt and one float32 model/device; not a general generation throughput benchmark and no generation memory peak is measured

gpu_cache_record_audit.selection: first validation row for each task, sorted by task name; selected without generation results
